resources.string: Total white blood cells in the sample
Selected count = fraction × sample size, where fraction = selected percentage ÷ 100. At the same fraction, a larger sample contains more selected cells unless the fraction is zero.

This classroom model counts only white blood cells (leukocytes) in a simulated sample. Sample sizes and percentages are invented, not clinical measurements or reference ranges. Neutrophils, eosinophils, and basophils are granulocytes. T cells, B cells, and natural killer cells are lymphocytes. Monocytes are a separate group.
